model.name: Component Type / Engineering BOM
model.purpose: Describe reusable type-level engineering composition distinctly from as-built assembly.
model.scope_statement: An engineering BOM revision owns occurrence relationships, quantities, applicability, selection, intended-property references and controlled exchange. Product types, designs, configured variants and physical items retain independent masters.
in_scope: Versioned engineering baseline and component occurrences
Quantities, graph integrity, effectivity and selection
Qualified nominal properties, functional contributions and governed change
out_of_scope: As-built item state, actual material consumption and inventory
Production routes, procurement execution and software BOM
Automatic physical action or certification from information validity

boundary_notes.distinction: Frozen COMPOSE relation: occurrences reference reusable component types, not copied product masters.
Design geometry and functional intent stay referenced, not remastered in the BOM.
Selection binds applicability; candidate lines do not imply installed components.
Engineering occurrence is not serialized item; manufacturing additions and process recursion require a separate view.

functions.name: Resolve applicable baseline
functions.description: Resolve one engineering baseline under explicit context, preserving ambiguity.

functions.name: Expand bounded composition
functions.description: Traverse occurrences without flattening identity or looping.
preconditions: Pinned dependencies and bounded traversal policy
effects: Stop on unresolved branch or cycle; no manufacturing recursion solver implied

functions.name: Qualify engineering quantities
functions.description: Describe dimensional calculation and override provenance; this contract supplies no calculation engine.
preconditions: Compatible units and declared conversion/rounding policy
effects: Do not count excluded alternatives or manufacturing scrap as intrinsic composition

functions.name: Bind configured selection
functions.description: Record constrained choices and qualified substitutions.
outputs: Selected occurrence set and open conflicts
preconditions: Approved applicable choices and interface evidence
effects: No universal interchangeability or installation inferred

functions.name: Review and release composition change
functions.description: Assess where-used impact and baseline authority.
preconditions: No unresolved blocking conflict; approver authorized
effects: Keep history, deviations and unknown downstream consumers visible

functions.name: Exchange composition with loss report
functions.description: Preserve source identity through target-view mappings.
outputs: Derivative artifact, mapping and loss report
preconditions: Disclosure permission and tested mapping criteria
effects: Reject required unsupported semantics; never overwrite source with projection

composition.purpose: Resolve controlled geometry and intended definition.
Bind selected variants without merging lifecycles.
Link as-built discrepancies without treating intent as observation.

composition.target: Manufacturing BOM, routing and procurement masters
composition.purpose: Preserve independent realization views and permissions.
Candidate exchange alignment only; licensed clauses and crosswalk deferred.

owner_package_requirements: Identify Dimension owner and composition authority.
Declare namespaces and component/BOM master registries.
Declare delegated release, federation, access and retention policies.
dimension.namespace_guidance: Issuer-qualified BOM IDs with immutable revisions and local occurrence IDs; displayed row numbers and filenames are not master identity.

canonicalization_rules: Preserve distinct occurrences, pinned revisions, engineering view and explicit unknowns.
A flattened projection never overwrites authoritative occurrence topology.
patch_rules: Authorized append-only revision or namespaced extension with expected-base digest; reject concurrent conflicts.
Reassess quantities, applicability, selection and where-used impact before release.
compatibility_rules: Changed engineering meaning requires a controlled revision, not silent replacement.
Preserve prior versions and explicit cross-view loss; deviations have bounded authority and applicability.

identity_priority: Dimension UUID with revision and digest
artifact_rules.timestamp_rule: RFC 3339 with seconds and UTC Z or numeric offset; distinguish recorded, approved and effective time.
artifact_rules.serial_naming_rule: Evidence type plus opaque master ID and revision; dates alone are insufficient.
artifact_rules.integrity_rule: Verify exact-byte digests and pinned dependencies. Never execute imported formulas, scripts, macros or instructions automatically.

policies: Information validity is not physical fit, safety, certification or authority to manufacture.
Do not sum alternatives or propagate incompatible units; incomplete and withheld branches remain explicit.
Vendor examples motivate proposed fields, not universal normative compliance.

read: Read AGENTS.md and owner policy; resolve baseline/view/context before traversing authorized component references.
create: Reuse the active authorized Dimension and existing product masters; create explicit partial engineering composition with stable occurrence IDs.
update: Apply expected-base checks and change review; preserve release history and reverse dependency impact.
delete: Retire first; respect retention and legal hold, dependent interpretation and authorized deletion. Preserve a minimized tombstone.

responsibilities: Owns baseline and approves applicability and change.

responsibilities: Maintains component bindings, quantities and evidence.

access.default_rule: Deny unless owning Dimension authorizes the exact scope and purpose.
exceptions: Explicit time-limited delegated exception only; no privilege inheritance from component containment.
audit_requirements: Record actor, purpose, scope, baseline, decision and disclosure receipt without secrets.

coverage.claim: Proposed engineering-composition information contract with twelve subject-specific records and thirty-six authored questions. No independent external review, operational solver or normative conformance is claimed.

checklist.notes: BOM revision versus component type versus occurrence.
COMPOSE product type and referenced design/variant masters.
Applicable versus recorded and approved time.
Composition owner versus component master and custodian.
Cycles, unresolved references and acceptance fixtures as proposed requirements.
Scoped disclosure with explicit withheld branches.
Occurrence preservation, view transformation and semantic losses.
Qualified nominal properties, not observed item state.
Features, designators and footprint references with ambiguity.
Nested schema, solver and real-product fixtures deferred.

known_omissions: No independent external research/review: Claude and Grok each timed out once. Codex-only owner waiver requires reviewable-draft assurance.
SAP support is indexed text only; licensed ISO clauses unread. Source-to-field normative compliance is not established.
Vendor documentation is selected and domain-specific, not exhaustive industry coverage. Alternate/substitute rules are proposed Vercy design needing specialist review.
Nested field groups are not an executable instance schema. No BOM solver, unit engine, CAD adapter or real-product round-trip fixtures delivered.
Actual physical properties and capability require design/component evidence; safety and certification are outside this contract.
Adopters must instantiate actual authority, retention, access, effectivity predicates and acceptance criteria.
regional_assumptions: Owning Dimension must declare contract, sector and jurisdiction requirements; no legal or manufacturing authorization inferred.
adversarial_checks: Reject component types conflated with installed serial items.
Reject row merging that destroys repeated occurrence identity.
Reject unknown quantities interpreted as zero or incompatible units multiplied.
Reject every alternate counted as simultaneously selected.
Distinguish group graph cycles from selected graph; stop bounded traversal.
Reject nominal aggregate property as measured safety or capability proof.
Reject silent latest revision, unauthorized disclosure or stale-base update.
